title: senecio nemorensis subsp. jacquinianus
intro: Senecio nemorensis subsp. jacquinianus, commonly known as Wood Germander, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Wood Germander include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
